name: kms_key_id
description: The ARN for the KMS encryption key if one is set to the cluster.

name: db_parameter_group_name
description: The name of a DB parameter group to use

name: tags
description: A map of tags to add to all resources.

name: performance_insights_enabled
description: Specifies whether Performance Insights is enabled or not.

name: performance_insights_kms_key_id
description: The ARN for the KMS key to encrypt Performance Insights data.

name: vpc_id
description: VPC ID

name: database_name
description: Name for an automatically created database on cluster creation

name: preferred_maintenance_window
description: When to perform DB maintenance

name: apply_immediately
description: Determines whether or not any DB modifications are applied immediately, or during the maintenance window

name: engine_version
description: Aurora database engine version.

name: subnets
description: List of subnet IDs to use

name: username
description: Master DB username

name: skip_final_snapshot
description: Should a final snapshot be created on cluster destroy

name: auto_minor_version_upgrade
description: Determines whether minor engine upgrades will be performed automatically in the maintenance window

name: allowed_security_groups
description: A list of Security Group ID's to allow access to.

name: monitoring_interval
description: The interval (seconds) between points when Enhanced Monitoring metrics are collected

name: snapshot_identifier
description: DB snapshot to create this database from

name: storage_encrypted
description: Specifies whether the underlying storage layer should be encrypted

name: password
description: Master DB password

name: preferred_backup_window
description: When to perform DB backups

name: engine
description: Aurora database engine type, currently aurora, aurora-mysql or aurora-postgresql

name: replica_scale_max
description: Maximum number of replicas to allow scaling for

name: replica_scale_min
description: Maximum number of replicas to allow scaling for

name: replica_scale_cpu
description: CPU usage to trigger autoscaling at

name: identifier_prefix
description: Prefix for cluster and instance identifier

name: final_snapshot_identifier_prefix
description: The prefix name to use when creating a final snapshot on cluster destroy, appends a random 8 digits to name to ensure it's unique too.

name: deletion_protection
description: If the DB instance should have deletion protection enabled

name: backup_retention_period
description: How long to keep backups for (in days)

name: instance_type
description: Instance type to use

name: publicly_accessible
description: Whether the DB should have a public IP address

name: replica_scale_enabled
description: Whether to enable autoscaling for RDS Aurora (MySQL) read replicas

name: replica_scale_in_cooldown
description: Cooldown in seconds before allowing further scaling operations after a scale in

name: replica_scale_out_cooldown
description: Cooldown in seconds before allowing further scaling operations after a scale out

name: name
description: Name given resources

name: replica_count
description: Number of reader nodes to create.  If `replica_scale_enable` is `true`, the value of `replica_scale_min` is used instead.

name: port
description: The port on which to accept connections

name: db_cluster_parameter_group_name
description: The name of a DB Cluster parameter group to use
